title: P15.10-C R3: cost authority & readiness closure — objective cap at the atomic reserve boundary, truthful runnable readiness, F1b coverage correction
description: R3 remediation on PR #87 (BASE 0e27bc6ee236d82633d4aee321ba9cd264adc0c3): F2/F3 CONFIRMED by prepatch repro (12/14 R3 tests failed pre-fix). F2: objective budget_microusd_cap was never bound at the real pre-spend boundary — assertAndReserve sees the governed task's actual route/executor identity but only summed business/department/agent/mission scopes. Fix inside the same atomic check-and-reserve txn: lineage resolved fresh (mission.bound_open_id -> work_open_binding -> workforce_allocation -> oap:<oid> cap); attributed liability (HELD/COMMITTED @reserved, SETTLED @settled, RELEASED skipped) + new reservation > cap -> FAIL_CLOSED_COST_OBJECTIVE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED; UNKNOWN/unbounded under a cap -> FAIL_CLOSED_COST_OBJECTIVE_UNVERIFIED (never $0). P13 hard-stops untouched; no second cost engine. Driver dispatchCostBound now route-aware (max over reachable executor/route/model profiles); stays a preliminary admission check only. F3: wired driver reported READY. New driver.readiness() derives runnable solely from canonical evidence (cursor READY + policy effective + queue not quarantined/blocked + provable cost binding + budget room); scheduler.status and both MC routes consume it — driver_integrated added, driver_ready/objective_runnable mean runnable, driver_missing carries real reasons, backward compatible. F1b: corrected R2 drift test to legitimate disable->configure->enable mid-await instead of invalid configure-on-ENABLED; F1 impl untouched. R1/R2 audited patches kept. No merge/deploy; driver opt-in OFF.
